messages:
Maya P: evening triage — current queue: 32 tickets. Breakdown: 3 P1 (2 infra, 1 payment), 6 P2, 23 P3. ETA for inbox zero tomorrow morning. :coffee:

Ben L: working on INF-247 (embeddings failures) — root cause looks like a rolling config diff in the redis cluster. I have a rollback checklist ready. ETA ~30m. Using macro `/macro embeddings-incident` for customer replies.

Alina S: handling two customer-facing P2s (TKT-9821, TKT-9833) — doing shard restarts and prepping safe restart notes. Need a KV from infra to safely drain nodes. Pinged @Tom R.

Tom R: on infra — scheduling a canary restart in 10m, will watch latency and error rate dashboards. Added alert suppression for duplicate errors during the window.

Maya P: support macros to use tonight: `/macro embeddings-status` (short status), `/macro embeddings-apology` (apology + credit), `/macro payments-ps` (payment slowness). Remember to replace `{{incident_id}}` and `{{eta}}`.

Ben L: quick Q — do we escalate INF-247 to #incidents? Current impact: partial embedding queries failing, but fallback to older model works. If we hit ~60+ customers affected, we should escalate.

Alina S: yes, escalate — several customers reported >5% error rate on similarity. Jess, can you open an incident and link INF-247 + the two P2 tickets?

Jess (support-bot): Created incident INC-2026-03-18-03 and posted the timeline template in #incidents. Linked: INF-247, TKT-9821, TKT-9833.

Tom R: rolling restart started at 1769534270. Canary node healthy so far, latency stable. Monitoring CPU and KV hit rate. Will update after next canary.

Ben L: I'll draft an outbound customer note (short status + mitigation + ETA). Drafting with `/macro embeddings-status` and will add `--affected: similarity` line.

Maya P: blockers: only INF-247 for now. Today: closed 7 tickets, triaged 20, updated KB on macro usage. Tomorrow: write runbook for redis config rollback and coordinate with infra for safer deploy windows.

Alina S: handoff to morning shift — continue monitoring INC-2026-03-18-03, pick up payment P1 if it escalates. I'm aligned on the on-call rotation for tomorrow morning.

Tom R: update: canary node CPU spiked but remained under threshold; second canary in progress. No regressions observed.

Ben L: FYI — draft posted to /support/templates/embeddings-status.md for review. Please add any customer-facing notes.

Maya P: thanks all :thumbsup: If no major regressions in next 20m I'll mark triage done for today and close the thread.
